runtime.name: omp
runtime.configuration: Generated Skill copied under project .agents/skills; includeSkills cleared and asynchronous jobs enabled by the parallel probe overlay.
runtime.permissionProfile: Only read, task, and hub tools enabled; fixture required no writes

assertions.evidence: The root explicitly loaded the generated check-parallel Skill.
One native task batch created LeftReader and RightReader, and progress snapshots showed both jobs running concurrently before hub wait.
Native hub wait watched both job ids until both separately attributable results were delivered.
LeftReader read only assets/left.txt and returned LEFT_MARKER=parallel-ok.
RightReader read only assets/right.txt and returned RIGHT_MARKER=parallel-ok.
The root read assets/root.txt before the batch and independently again after both results.
Only read, task, and hub tools were enabled and the external post-run Git status was clean.

limitations: This fixture proves parallel read-only fan-out and asynchronous wait-all, not follow-up, cancellation, transcript access, or writer isolation.
OMP remains overall D0 because its separate plugin-manager dry-run probe failed the D1 safety gate.
